title: Backpass: a tool that reads your agent's transcripts and rewrites AGENTS.md from what went wrong
description:
Backpass treats AGENTS.md like a model you improve from its own mistakes. It finds local coding-agent transcripts, strips tool noise and obvious secrets, then looks for repeated failures that justify a small instruction change. Every proposal includes quotes from real sessions, new rules need evidence from at least two sessions, and nothing writes until you approve it. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/kunchenguid/backpass
